description: Repeated substrings of a DNA sequence with all 0-based positions (overlapping occurrences counted, ascending). Default: every distinct substring of length >= minLength occurring at least twice, including all prefixes/suffixes of longer repeats, ordered by the smallest suffix starting with the repeat then by length. maximalOnly=true: only Gusfield maximal repeats (left- and right-diverse: cannot be extended on either side without losing an occurrence; text ends count as distinct), the strings behind REPuter/MUMmer self matches. bothStrands=true: repeat CLASSES over both strands as MUMmer repeat-match / Vmatch -p (a string and its reverse complement are one class, reported as the smaller of the two; positions = forward starts, reversePositions = forward-strand starts of the windows that spell its reverse complement; a palindrome such as GAATTC is a repeat at a single site); the classes are ordered by string. IUPAC input (e.g. N runs of an assembly) is accepted: only A/C/G/T can repeat, a window containing N or another ambiguity code never repeats and an N next to a repeat makes it non-extendable.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive); non-A/C/G/T symbols never repeat.

maximalOnly.description: Report only maximal repeats (Gusfield 1997 sec. 7.12; default false = every repeated substring).

bothStrands.description: Search both strands: classes of a string and its reverse complement (MUMmer repeat-match default). Default false = forward strand only.

maxOutputMegabytes.description: Limit of the output in megabytes (default 512; 0 = no limit): the size of the result (label characters, occurrences, repeats) is computed from the suffix tree before anything is built, and a larger one is REFUSED with the sizes in the message (every repeated substring of a low-complexity sequence is quadratic: poly-A of length 20 000 is 19 998 repeats, 200 M occurrences, 1.9 GB; 50 000 about 12 GB). Raise minLength, set maximalOnly or raise this limit.

reversePositions.description: bothStrands only: forward-strand starts of the windows that spell the reverse complement of sequence

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Minimum repeat length must be at least 1

The repeats of this sequence would be N substrings with M occurrences and C characters (about X MB), which exceeds the limit of L MB (RepeatOutputLimits): raise minLength, ask for the maximal repeats only, or raise maxOutputMegabytes (0 = no limit)
